zh.d:
本版把体验打磨和链路加固做实：外网访问隧道全面换成自研实现，桌面端不再携带任何额外可执行文件；「员工与场景」页面重设计；「工作中」状态改为会话流内联显示；WebUI 手机端完成 H5 适配。引擎侧长上下文压缩沿用主对话前缀以命中提示词缓存，压缩更省钱也更快。

【新增】
· 【外网访问隧道】全面改用自研实现（Node 客户端 + WebSocket 中继）：安装包不再携带 frpc 等额外可执行文件，杀毒软件不再误报「黑客工具」；一条 wss/443 连接复用所有访客请求，传输窗口按链路自适应放大到 4MiB，跨洋弱网更快；断线自动退避重连，100MB 下载、WebSocket、链接吊销等外网真机验证通过
· 【记忆导出】记忆管理标题栏新增「导出」：引擎记忆、Claude 自动记忆、其他智能体全局指令汇总成一个 Markdown 文件，桌面端另存为、网页端直接下载
· 【场景头像】场景编辑器新增「上传图片」与「默认」：居中裁剪缩至 192px 小体积保存，场景列表、会话欢迎区、导入导出一致展示

【优化改进】
· 【员工与场景】页面改名为「员工与场景」，卡片重设计为紧凑上下结构，数字员工页与场景页风格统一，创建按钮与数量同行
· 【工作中状态】「工作中 + 计时」改为会话流末尾内联显示（转圈 + 本轮耗时），输入框上方状态条只保留有具体内容的提示；「正在处理…」统一为「工作中」
· 【长上下文压缩】压缩请求沿用主对话前缀，命中提示词缓存——压缩更省钱、响应更快；压缩用量计入会话统计
· 【登录页语言】网页端首次访问未登录时按浏览器语言选择界面语言（中文浏览器→简体/繁体），不再固定英文
· 【修改密码】弹窗写明真实规则（至少 8 位、拒绝常见弱密码），后端拒绝原因本地化为中文（此前恒显英文）
· 【设置项】「连接方式」改为「内网访问」，与「外网访问」对应（13 种语言）
· 【资料库】窄窗口下目录抽屉加遮罩，点空白或 Esc 收起；侧栏开关图标加悬停提示
· 【WebUI 手机端】会话中心卡片流、频道表单、设置页重排等 H5 适配，新增底部快捷导航

【修复】
· 【隧道】修复弱网访客打开页面白屏转圈：静态资源增加 gzip 压缩（此前 12.5MB 裸传）
· 【Linux】无桌面环境下 onework --webui 自动以 headless 重启
· 【主题】消除色主题下设置页头的浮块色带
· 【手机端】修复底部导航选中色因失效 CSS 写法不生效
· 【语言切换】图标改为翻译图标，去掉对话框默认的「正在处理中」文案

本版企业侧共享模型价格与计费计量的全套升级，同时同步单机版的全部引擎与会话修复。

【新增】
· 【模型价格】管理后台新增「模型价格」总表：单价按模型名独立保存，支持按 Token/按张/按输出秒/按次计费与分辨率档位，输入输出可留空按 0；每个价格自选 USD/RMB，人民币固定按 1 USD = ¥7 折算成本
· 【查价与同步】「点我试试获取价格」依次查公司 LiteLLM/中转站、公开 LiteLLM 价格库；支持批量同步、直接粘贴浏览器复制的价格 JSON、按中转站后端名匹配上游型号；来源需登录时改用管理员自己的浏览器认证并自动继续
· 【缓存计量】企业通道代理补抓 OpenAI 兼容协议与 DeepSeek 的缓存命中数，消费日志缓存读取/写入不再恒为 0

【优化改进】
· 【长上下文压缩】压缩请求沿用主对话前缀以命中提示词缓存，压缩用量计入统计（与单机版一致）

【加固】
· 查价拒绝 link-local/元数据地址（含重定向目标）；媒体用量异常大值改为饱和乘法，不再回绕成负数绕过花费上限

en.d:
This release polishes the experience and hardens the pipeline: the external access tunnel moves fully to a self-built implementation so the desktop app no longer ships any extra executables; the "Employees & Scenes" pages are redesigned; the running status becomes an inline part of the conversation flow; and the WebUI gets full mobile H5 adaptation. On the engine side, context compaction now reuses the main conversation prefix to hit the prompt cache - cheaper and faster.

[New]
· External access tunnel: fully self-built (Node client + WebSocket relay) - the installer no longer carries frpc or any extra executable, so antivirus no longer flags it as a hacking tool; one wss/443 connection multiplexes all visitor requests, with the transfer window growing adaptively up to 4MiB for faster cross-ocean links; automatic reconnection with backoff, verified on a real external network with 100MB downloads, WebSockets and link revocation
· Memory export: a new "Export" button in the memory manager title bar compiles engine memory, Claude auto memory and other agents' global instructions into one Markdown file - save-as on desktop, direct download on the web
· Scene avatars: the scene editor gains "Upload Image" and "Default" - centered crop shrinks to 192px for tiny storage, shown consistently in the scene list, session welcome area and import/export

[Improved]
· Employees & Scenes: the page is renamed "Employees & Scenes" with compact vertical cards, unified styling across both pages, and the create button and count on one line
· Running status: "working + timer" moves inline to the end of the conversation flow (spinner + elapsed time), and the bar above the input box only keeps prompts with concrete content; "Processing..." is unified to "Working"
· Context compaction: compaction requests reuse the main conversation prefix to hit the prompt cache - cheaper and faster; compaction usage now counts into session statistics
· Login page language: on first visit before login, the web app picks the interface language by browser language (Chinese browser → Simplified/Traditional Chinese) instead of always English
· Password change: the dialog states the real rules (at least 8 characters, common weak passwords rejected) and backend rejection reasons are localized into Chinese (previously always English)
· Settings wording: "Connection mode" is renamed "LAN access" to match "External access" (13 languages)
· Knowledge library: the directory drawer gains a mask in narrow windows, closing on blank-click or Esc; sidebar toggle icons gain hover tooltips
· WebUI on mobile: H5 adaptation for the sessions center card flow, channel forms and settings page layout, plus a new bottom quick navigation

[Fixed]
· Tunnel: visitors on weak networks no longer face a spinning blank page - static assets are now served with gzip compression (previously 12.5MB was sent uncompressed)
· Linux: onework --webui automatically relaunches in headless mode on desktop-less systems
· Theme: removes the floating color band on the settings page header with colorful themes
· Mobile: fixes the bottom navigation selected color that never applied due to invalid CSS syntax
· Language switch: the icon becomes a translation icon and the dialog's default "Processing" text is removed

The enterprise side shares the full upgrade of model pricing and usage metering, together with all engine and session fixes from the personal edition.

[New]
· Model pricing: a new "Model prices" table in the admin console - unit prices are stored per model name, support per-token / per-image / per-output-second / per-call billing with resolution tiers, empty input/output prices count as 0; each price picks USD or RMB, with RMB converted to USD cost at 1 USD = ¥7
· Price lookup & sync: "Try fetching prices" queries the company LiteLLM / relay stations first, then the public LiteLLM price library; supports batch sync, pasting price JSON copied from the browser, matching upstream models by relay backend name; when a source requires login, the admin's own browser authenticates and continues automatically
· Cache metering: the enterprise channel proxy now captures cache hit counts for the OpenAI-compatible protocol and DeepSeek, so cached read/write in the consumption log is no longer always 0

[Improved]
· Context compaction: compaction requests reuse the main conversation prefix to hit the prompt cache and compaction usage counts into statistics (matching the personal edition)

[Hardened]
· Price lookup rejects link-local/metadata addresses (including redirect targets); abnormally large media usage values are saturated-multiplied so they can no longer wrap into negatives to bypass spend limits
